description: Test commands to run from workload instance after deployment
note: Replace <LATTICE_RESOURCE_DNS> with the actual DNS from your deployment
commands: timeout 5 bash -c 'echo > /dev/tcp/<LATTICE_RESOURCE_DNS>/3128' 2>/dev/null && echo 'TCP connection successful' || echo 'TCP connection failed'
echo '=== HTTP CONNECT Test (HTTPS via proxy) ==='
important: DO NOT use the NFW Proxy VPCE domain directly (vpce-xxx.proxy.nfw...). Use the Lattice Resource DNS which resolves to VPC Lattice IPs (129.224.x.x or 169.254.x.x)
